title: RAG & Agentic AI Systems
blurb: Embeddings, retrieval, RAG pipelines, agent loops, multi-agent orchestration, voice agents, guardrails.

lecture.summary: Build retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI from scratch — dense retrieval (bi-encoders), vector indexing, RAG pipelines (retrieve-then-generate), query rewriting (HyDE), reranking, RAG evaluation, tool-using agents (ReAct), memory systems, and multi-agent orchestration — all without external API keys.
takeaways: Dense retrieval, vector indexing, and retrieve-then-generate RAG pipelines.
Query rewriting (HyDE), reranking, and RAG evaluation (RAGAS-style).
Tool-using agents (ReAct), memory systems, and multi-agent orchestration.

snippet.caption: RAG: retrieve first, then condition generation on it.
snippet.code:
docs = index.search(embed(query), k=5)        # find relevant context
answer = llm(prompt(query, context=docs))     # ground the answer in facts

subLessons.title: RAG and Agents
subLessons.intro: Turning a raw model into a grounded, reliable, safe system: chunk and retrieve the right context, rerank it, let the model act in a loop, and guard the edges.
